title: Very, very thin. Pretty colors!
text: Very, very thin. Pretty colors!. This really isn’t a rug. It’s a mat. It’s super flat with absolutely no pile. The design is just printed on the top. The backing is pretty much non-slip. It’s great to use by a front door because you don’t have to worry about the clearance when the door opens. I was expecting a fluffier rug. It works in its location and the colors are very very pretty. Easy to clean. You can sweep or vacuum. You can also wash this in the washing machine.
